answer: Each challenge is bound to a commitment derived from a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: until the drand quorum reveals its unpredictable, collectively signed value, an agent cannot know the instance or its scoring path. Thus, a sybil swarm cannot precompute answers, cheaply farm offline, or reuse work across identities; the pulse acts as an inlet, while verification links each response to a trellis of commitments that no participant can forge.
